questions.notes: Pre-registration lineup: הציונות הדתית (4) and עוצמה יהודית (9) shown as separate rows - both mapped to 'הציונות הדתית' since they ran as one list (combined 13 seats, 10.5%). Joint List (חד"ש, בל"ד, תע"ל) shown as ONE list - mapped to חד"ש-תע"ל per spec. הרוח הציונית (Shaked/Hendel) mapped to הבית היהודי. pct is 'אחוזים (נתונים גולמיים)' (raw), sums to 100% among those naming a party. Sample includes a 450-person oversample of 2021 Labor/Meretz voters in addition to the 450 national sample; seat forecast presumably weighted to national representation.

extraction_notes: Poll commissioned by Ilan Shiloah (private), conducted by Kantar, published 30/08/2022; fieldwork 24 Aug 2022 (13:00) - 25 Aug 2022 (15:15). Total 900 respondents = 450 national representative + 450 oversample of 2021 Labor/Meretz voters; margin of error +-4.6% is per sub-sample. Page 4 (support for a Labor-Meretz merger among Labor/Meretz voters) ignored as not vote intention.
